name: Instagram
shortDescription: Photo and video sharing social network.
longDescription: Instagram is a social platform for sharing photos and videos, watching short-form Reels, messaging people, and discovering creators and interests.

name: Facebook
shortDescription: Social networking for connecting with people and communities.
longDescription: Facebook lets people connect with friends and family, join communities, follow pages, share posts, watch videos, and use Marketplace and other services.

name: WhatsApp
shortDescription: Private messaging and calling app.
longDescription: WhatsApp provides messaging, voice calls, video calls, group chats, communities, media sharing, and status updates with end-to-end encryption for personal messages and calls.

name: TikTok
shortDescription: Short-form video and entertainment platform.
longDescription: TikTok is a short-form video platform where people create, watch, discover, and share videos across many interests and trends.

name: Snapchat
shortDescription: Messaging and visual communication app.
longDescription: Snapchat combines camera-based messaging with Stories, Spotlight, lenses, filters, and conversations between friends.

name: Reddit
shortDescription: Community discussion and content platform.
longDescription: Reddit is organized into communities where users share links, posts, questions, discussions, images, and videos around specific interests.

name: Pinterest
shortDescription: Visual discovery and idea-sharing platform.
longDescription: Pinterest helps people discover, save, organize, and share visual ideas covering topics such as recipes, fashion, home projects, travel, and design.

name: X
shortDescription: Real-time conversation and social platform.
longDescription: X is a social platform for public posts, conversations, news, communities, direct messages, live video, and other real-time content.

name: Threads
shortDescription: Text-based social conversation app.
longDescription: Threads is a social conversation platform from Instagram for sharing text updates, photos, videos, links, and participating in public discussions.

name: Discord
shortDescription: Community chat platform for text, voice, and video.
longDescription: Discord provides servers, channels, direct messages, voice rooms, video calls, screen sharing, and communities for shared interests and gaming.

name: Free Fire
shortDescription: Fast-paced mobile battle royale game.
longDescription: Free Fire is a mobile battle royale game where players compete in matches, collect equipment, and try to survive until the end.

name: PUBG MOBILE
shortDescription: Competitive mobile battle royale shooter.
longDescription: PUBG MOBILE is a multiplayer battle royale game featuring large maps, survival matches, team play, and competitive modes.

name: Roblox
shortDescription: Online platform for user-created games and experiences.
longDescription: Roblox is an online platform where users can play and create interactive experiences, communicate with others, and explore a large library of community-created content.

name: Minecraft
shortDescription: Sandbox game about building and exploration.
longDescription: Minecraft is a sandbox game focused on exploring worlds, gathering resources, crafting items, building structures, and playing in different game modes.

name: Clash of Clans
shortDescription: Strategy game about building villages and clans.
longDescription: Clash of Clans is a strategy game where players build villages, train troops, defend bases, and cooperate or compete through clans.

name: Candy Crush Saga
shortDescription: Match-three puzzle game.
longDescription: Candy Crush Saga is a puzzle game based on matching candies to complete level objectives, with boosters and progressively challenging stages.

name: Call of Duty: Mobile
shortDescription: Mobile action shooter with multiplayer modes.
longDescription: Call of Duty: Mobile brings multiplayer and battle royale gameplay to mobile devices with maps, modes, weapons, and seasonal content.

name: eFootball
shortDescription: Football simulation game for mobile devices.
longDescription: eFootball is a football game featuring licensed teams and players, competitive matches, team building, and online gameplay.

name: 8 Ball Pool
shortDescription: Online pool game.
longDescription: 8 Ball Pool is a multiplayer billiards game where players compete in pool matches, earn coins, and progress through different tables and competitions.

name: Subway Surfers
shortDescription: Endless runner game.
longDescription: Subway Surfers is an endless runner where players navigate railway tracks, avoid obstacles, collect items, and progress through changing locations.

name: Amazon Shopping
shortDescription: Online marketplace for products and services.
longDescription: Amazon Shopping lets customers browse product categories, compare listings, place orders, manage deliveries, and access Amazon services.

name: eBay
shortDescription: Marketplace for buying and selling products.
longDescription: eBay is an online marketplace supporting product listings, auctions, fixed-price purchases, seller tools, order tracking, and buyer protection programs.

name: Etsy
shortDescription: Marketplace for handmade and creative goods.
longDescription: Etsy connects shoppers with independent sellers offering handmade items, personalized products, craft supplies, vintage goods, and creative products.

name: Walmart
shortDescription: Shopping app for products, groceries, and services.
longDescription: Walmart's app supports shopping for products and groceries, pickup and delivery options, order tracking, and access to Walmart services.

name: AliExpress
shortDescription: Global online shopping marketplace.
longDescription: AliExpress is a global marketplace connecting shoppers with sellers offering electronics, fashion, home products, accessories, and many other categories.

name: SHEIN
shortDescription: Online fashion and lifestyle shopping platform.
longDescription: SHEIN is an online retailer focused on fashion, accessories, beauty, home products, and lifestyle items with a global customer base.

name: Temu
shortDescription: Online marketplace with products across many categories.
longDescription: Temu is an online marketplace offering products across categories including home, electronics, fashion, accessories, and everyday goods.

name: Etsy Seller
shortDescription: Seller management app for Etsy shops.
longDescription: Etsy Seller provides tools for Etsy shop owners to manage listings, orders, messages, inventory, and shop activity from mobile devices.

name: Daraz
shortDescription: Online shopping marketplace popular in South Asia.
longDescription: Daraz is an e-commerce marketplace serving South Asian markets with categories such as electronics, fashion, beauty, home products, and groceries.

name: Shop
shortDescription: Shopping and order tracking app.
longDescription: Shop helps customers discover products, follow orders, and manage purchases from participating online stores.

name: Google Chrome
shortDescription: Web browser for browsing the internet.
longDescription: Google Chrome is a web browser for accessing websites, managing tabs, using bookmarks, syncing browsing data, and supporting modern web applications.

name: Spotify
shortDescription: Music and podcast streaming service.
longDescription: Spotify provides access to music, podcasts, playlists, albums, artists, and personalized recommendations through streaming.

name: Netflix
shortDescription: Streaming service for films and television shows.
longDescription: Netflix is a subscription streaming service offering movies, television series, documentaries, and Netflix-produced content on supported devices.

name: YouTube
shortDescription: Video platform for watching and sharing videos.
longDescription: YouTube hosts user-created and professional video content, live streams, music, educational material, Shorts, and creator channels.

name: ChatGPT
shortDescription: AI assistant for conversation, writing, learning, and problem solving.
longDescription: ChatGPT is an AI assistant that can help users with questions, writing, coding, learning, brainstorming, and other supported tasks.

name: Canva
shortDescription: Graphic design and visual content creation platform.
longDescription: Canva provides templates and tools for creating presentations, social posts, documents, videos, posters, graphics, and other visual content.

name: Google Maps
shortDescription: Maps, navigation, and local discovery app.
longDescription: Google Maps provides maps, directions, navigation, place information, traffic data, public transit information, and local business discovery.

name: Google Drive
shortDescription: Cloud storage and file management service.
longDescription: Google Drive stores files in the cloud and supports file organization, sharing, collaboration, and access across supported devices.

name: Google Photos
shortDescription: Photo and video backup and organization service.
longDescription: Google Photos helps users back up, organize, search, edit, and share photos and videos across supported devices.

name: Gmail
shortDescription: Email service for personal and professional communication.
longDescription: Gmail provides email messaging, inbox organization, spam protection, search, attachments, labels, and integration with Google services.

name: Microsoft Teams
shortDescription: Work and study communication and collaboration platform.
longDescription: Microsoft Teams supports chat, meetings, calls, file sharing, collaboration, and team-based communication for work and education.

name: Notion
shortDescription: Workspace for notes, documents, databases, and projects.
longDescription: Notion combines notes, documents, databases, task management, project organization, and team collaboration in a flexible workspace.

name: Duolingo
shortDescription: Language-learning app with gamified lessons.
longDescription: Duolingo provides structured language-learning lessons with exercises for vocabulary, reading, listening, speaking, and practice.

name: Google Meet
shortDescription: Video meeting and calling service.
longDescription: Google Meet provides video meetings and calls with features such as screen sharing, captions, chat, and collaboration for supported accounts.

name: Adobe Acrobat Reader
shortDescription: PDF reading and document management app.
longDescription: Adobe Acrobat Reader lets users view, annotate, sign, share, and manage PDF documents on supported devices.

name: Google Calendar
shortDescription: Calendar and scheduling app.
longDescription: Google Calendar helps users organize events, meetings, reminders, schedules, invitations, and shared calendars.

name: Google Translate
shortDescription: Translation app supporting many languages.
longDescription: Google Translate provides text and other supported translation features between languages, including camera and conversation tools on supported devices.

name: Microsoft OneDrive
shortDescription: Cloud storage and file synchronization service.
longDescription: OneDrive stores files and photos in the cloud and supports synchronization, sharing, organization, and access across devices.

name: Zoom Workplace
shortDescription: Video meetings and workplace collaboration platform.
longDescription: Zoom Workplace provides video meetings, chat, collaboration, and communication features for individuals, teams, schools, and organizations.

name: Google Keep
shortDescription: Simple notes and list-taking app.
longDescription: Google Keep lets users create notes, checklists, reminders, drawings, labels, and shared notes with synchronization across supported devices.
